false_positive_found_and_fixed.measured_cause: The matched node is <operator>.assignment whose code is the entire 1,000-character arrow function. The prototype sink 'set' matched the English word in the comment '// set these up in case we have an error case'. The handler calls no set.
false_positive_found_and_fixed.fix: taint.sc sinkMatches confines its text clause to the callee and excludes operator nodes
false_positive_found_and_fixed.note: Every dropped match is an operator node or an enclosing call whose body merely spells the word. req.query was an injection sink under the old rule, because 'query' is word-bounded inside it. The three eval calls and the res.redirect survive, and their witnesses now name the sink call rather than the assignment that contained it.

silent_families_diagnosed.untrusted_destination_on_nodegoat: NodeGoat's documented SSRF is needle.get(req.query.url + req.query.symbol) at app/routes/research.js:16. needle.get is absent from the sink vocabulary, which holds axios/fetch/got/http.get/request. The family works; its vocabulary is thin. Recall gap.
silent_families_diagnosed.output_encoding_on_nodegoat: All six declared sinks are DOM sinks (innerHTML, document.write, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML, outerHTML, v-html). NodeGoat's XSS is server-side, rendered into Swig templates and written with res.write, so no question the family can ask could have found it. Structural gap: server-rendered output has no sink vocabulary in JavaScript.
silent_families_diagnosed.access_control_on_nodegoat: Measured with the real dominance query: every modelled data operation in NodeGoat lives in app/data/*-dao.js or artifacts/db-reset.js, and none in a route handler file. Operations are scoped to the region's own file, and access_control regions are the handler files, so no obligation is ever raised where the question is asked. In the DAO files every operation is equally unguarded, so the sibling-contradiction rung has nothing to contradict. The two documented defects are also outside the model's expressible claims: an IDOR that reads userId from req.params on an authenticated route (app/routes/allocations.js:17), and a commented-out isAdmin in the route table (app/routes/index.js:58). Structural gap: the model asks about one file, and this application splits route from query.
silent_families_diagnosed.four_families_on_vampi: deserialization, output_encoding, path and untrusted_destination asked nothing because VAmPI's eleven Python files contain no sink for any of them; the only match of any such token is os.path.join in config.py. Correct silence, not a gap.
silent_families_diagnosed.prototype: Never established anywhere. Its only report was the false positive above. VAmPI is Python and the family is JavaScript-only, so it has been asked on one repository.

limits: Two repositories, both used to develop the analyser. Nothing here qualifies a capability.
Findings are counted at the rung the scan reached, all model_entailed; no execution confirmation.
A family silent on two repositories is untested, not absent.
